## Brand Identity & Corporate Legacy
- Developer: Shapoorji Pallonji Real Estate (SPRE) / Joyville Shapoorji Housing Scheme
- Corporate Heritage: 160+ years of institutional engineering excellence across India and the globe (Builders of RBI Mumbai, Palace of the Sultan of Oman, Imperial Towers Mumbai).
- Headquarters: SP Centre, 41/44 Minoo Desai Marg, Colaba, Mumbai 400005.
- Pune Regional Corporate Office: SP Infocity, Phursungi IT Park, Hadapsar, Pune - 412308.
- Official Website: https://joyville-homes.com
- Contact: sales@joyville-homes.com | +91-20-6743-1149
- Total Pune Footprint: Over 1,000+ acres across Western & Eastern Pune corridors.

## Macro-Economic & Investment Intelligence (Pune Corridors)

### Hinjewadi Phase 1 IT Corridor (Joyville Vyomora & Sensorium)
- Rental Yield: 4.8% - 5.4% (Highest sustained rental yield in Western Pune due to 400,000+ tech employees in Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park).
- Annual Capital Appreciation: 11.5% - 13.0% YoY.
- Key Infrastructure Catalysts:
  * Pune Metro Line 3 (Hinjewadi Megapolis to Civil Court / Shivajinagar) - Direct station within 5 minutes.
  * 128-km Pune Ring Road connecting Hinjewadi to Chakan, Talegaon, and Purandar.
  * Direct access to Mumbai-Pune Expressway bypass via Maan-Mhalunge road.

### Hadapsar & Shewalewadi Corridor (Joyville Hadapsar Annexe, Celestia, Skyluxe, Wildernest)
- Rental Yield: 4.2% - 4.8% (Driven by proximity to SP Infocity, Magarpatta Cybercity, and EON Free Zone Kharadi).
- Annual Capital Appreciation: 9.8% - 11.2% YoY.
- Key Infrastructure Catalysts:
  * Pune-Solapur National Highway (NH-65) 6-lane elevated corridor expansion.
  * Proposed Hadapsar Metro interchange linking Line 1 extension and Line 2.
  * SP Infocity IT Park housing 40,000+ employees within 3 km.

### Bavdhan & Kothrud Extension Corridor (Vanaha, Vanaha Golfland, Vanaha Springs)
- Rental Yield: 3.8% - 4.4% (Premium nature-seeking and senior-executive demographic).
- Annual Capital Appreciation: 10.5% - 12.0% YoY.
- Key Infrastructure Catalysts:
  * Chandani Chowk Multi-Level Flyover (Operational - seamless transit to Kothrud, Baner, and Hinjewadi in under 15 mins).
  * 1,000-acre green canopy maintaining AQI 35-50% superior to central Pune.
